brief:
# Issue123: compose the source-facing extraction theorem

Fresh Sol/Ultra author, one bounded task. MAIN holds atomic main-fix123 as an
ISSUE/declaration reservation, not a task on historical PR123. Work only in
/home/drx/MIPStarRE-qpbt/.worktrees/issue-123-source-unitary-composition-20260918,
branch issue-123-source-unitary-composition-20260918, trusted published-main
base4cfa73320d8f9b7bc3ef2a2dfbc40f242e94d54c. MAIN runs canonical setup
--no-build and --check before activation. Use PRIMARY local/bin workflow tools.

The concrete gap is documented in current
docs/paper-gaps/qpbt_extraction-transfer.tex and source blueprint
lem:qld-unitary: main proves exists_globalPairWitness and
exists_extractionWitness_ofGlobalPairWitness, but has no source-facing
declaration composing them. Issue123 explicitly owns this connection. The
conditional extraction proof packet, issue523, is closed and must not be
re-proved. The completed global constructor is new usable evidence for this
composition, not permission to reset older analytical proof budgets.

Duplicate check already performed: no exact theorem exists_extractionWitness
in primary or any registered worktree, and none in the 29 supersession reports.
The conditional names are widespread historical copies. Recheck equivalent
current APIs before implementing. PR456 is held by an Opus integration fixer;
PRs398/539/543/271 have publication owners. Do not touch their worktrees or
duplicate their saved results. The range-projection/ancilla support packet
78624dcf is still unpublished and is NOT a dependency of this task.

Read trusted AGENTS/formalization/proof-integrity/prose/blueprint policies, then
the SOURCE paper before implementation: references/qpbt-paper/
14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex, lem:qld-unitary at1666-1860 and its
global-measurement construction assumptions at1267-1274. Read current source
blueprint lem:qld-unitary and its conditional support node, then Unitary.lean,
Combining/Apply.lean and Extraction/Construction.lean. Inspect the actual
assumptions and mathematical carriers, not only names or existing leanok tags.

Goal: implement the missing source-facing extraction existence theorem,
preferably named exists_extractionWitness, deriving its global measurement
internally from the proved constructor and then applying the proved conditional
extraction result. Universal error constants must precede all parameter and
strategy quantifiers. Preserve the full admissible domain, including epsilon0
and epsilon1, all heterogeneous Alice/Bob registers, a normalized auxiliary
state, both concrete swap unitaries, state proximity and both Pauli-family
proximities. Retain the faithful nested deltaConstructPaulis/deltaExtract scale;
reuse deltaExtract_le_deltaQld if an error-family comparison is actually needed.
Do not weaken the bounds or move a missing producer into the hypotheses.

The source-facing result must have NO supplied GlobalPairWitness input. A
constructed witness as an existential output is appropriate. Do not treat a
one-line wrapper as source-faithful until the paper/blueprint hypotheses,
carrier/domain and conclusions match. If an additional source-domain or
mathematical obstruction prevents the composition, report the precise missing
fact and checkpoint; do not silently substitute another conditional helper,
broaden the task or add an unsupported completion tag. In particular, do not
erase unrelated seed-indexed/direct-law import restrictions merely because a
constructor has a completed kernel proof.

Scope: minimal existing-style Lean integration. A small dedicated source
composition module importing the existing constructor and conditional theorem,
plus the QPBT re-export, is preferable if it preserves the import DAG; choose
the repository's natural location after inspecting dependencies. Keep existing
conditional public APIs and their proved bodies. Correct only directly related
stale status prose/markers in Unitary.lean if justified, the existing chapter16
source/conditional nodes, qpbt_extraction-transfer.tex and corresponding gap
register entry. Retire an Unfaithful marker only for the exact deviation now
discharged; do not globally remove markers or reclassify other source gaps.
Do not change pauli_soundness, the final isometry-transfer claim, unrelated
proof holes, existing proof packets, or whole old source/chapter files.

Validation: focused Lean, targeted module build as needed, fresh #print axioms
for the new theorem and its two producer dependencies, no new proof debt,
blueprint render and canonical --update-lean-decls/--ci synchronization,
relevant paper-gap and statement-integrity checks, diff checks and ordinary
commit hooks. Proof-level leanok for the source node is permitted only after
both mathematical correspondence and standard-only transitive axioms are
verified. No full build/ci.sh in this author task. Preserve acyclic imports.

Make one ordinary-hook local commit when coherent. Write
/tmp/issue123-source-unitary-20260918-* receipt, exact statement-integrity audit
(paper/Lean assumptions and conclusions, verdict and scope limits), source and
duplicate evidence, commands/exit results, axiom probe/logs, honest PR draft
with Motivation/Description/Testing and Addresses #123, plus a sha256sum
manifest. Explicitly retain the other unfinished issue123 targets and the old
attempt history; do not claim the parent issue or final soundness complete.

No push, PR open, status/review/comment publication, actual merge/gate,
original-worktree or primary writes, codex exec/dispatch.sh/review.sh/autofix,
lanes, descendants, alternate keys, cache/package resets or global process
termination. This is a first bounded composition task using completed producer
proofs, not a new attempt at their closed proof problems. Maximum900 seconds
from task_started; reserve final180 seconds for checks/checkpoint/receipt and
stop at that deadline with exact evidence even if incomplete. One task, then
stop for MAIN's actual delta accounting and retirement.
